buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Terms & Conditions / Additional Terms & Conditions (ATC) Compost Bins-50 Nos A. Bidder Eligibility and Qualification 1. OEM / Authorized Dealer Requirement The bidder must be an Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) or an authorized dealer/distributor of an OEM speciali zing in municipal waste management equipment. In case of an authorized dealer/distributor, a valid Manufacturer’s Authorization Form (MAF) must be submitted along with the bid. 2. Financial Capability The bidder must have an average annual financial turnover amounting to Rs 12 Lacs during the last three consecuti ve financial years. A valid certificate issued by a Chartered Accountant (CA), clearly indicating the annual turnover f or the relevant financial years, must be uploaded with the technical bid. 3. Past Performance / Similar Supply Experience The bidder/OEM must have successfully executed supply contracts for the same or similar products to any Central G overnment/State Government Department, Public Sector Undertaking (PSU), Autonomous Body, or Urban Local Body (ULB) during the last three financial years. 4. Documentary Proof of Past Performance For establishing the above past-performance criteria, the bidder must submit legible copies of the relevant Work Or ders/Purchase Orders along with corresponding Completion Certificates or Performance Certificates issued by the re spective client organizations. These documents must be uploaded with the technical bid. B. Technical Specifications and Quality Requirements 5. The technical specifications, quality standards, performance parameters, and all other relevant requirements shal l be strictly in accordance with the details, guidelines, and conditions specified in the buyer uploaded document. C. Physical Sample and Technical Evaluation 6. Submission of Physical Sample

All technically qualified bidders shall be required to deliver one physical sample of the Compost bin to the Buye r’s designated office within 7 days from the date of opening of technical bid (or as and when required by t he Technical evaluation committee during the evaluation process), at their own cost. 7. Rejection of Non-Compliant Sample Failure to submit the required physical sample if demanded, within the stipulated period, or failure of the submitted sample to satisfy the prescribed technical requirements during inspection, shall render the bidder technically non-re sponsive. In such cases, the financial bid shall not be considered for opening. D. Quality Certifications and OEM Documentation 8. OEM Quality Management and Environmental Certifications The bidder must submit valid and legible copies of the following certificates of the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM): · ISO 9001:2015. · ISO 14001:2015. E. Earnest Money Deposit and Performance Security 9. Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) EMD shall be mandatory for all participating bidders. The bidder shall submit an EMD equivalent to 2% of the esti mated bid value, i.e. ₹30,000, in the form of Demand Draft (DD) or Bank Guarantee (BG), drawn in favour of the Buyer organization, as specified in the bid documents. 10. Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) The successful bidder shall furnish a Performance Security/PBG equivalent to 3% of the total contract value withi n 15 days from the date of receipt of the Letter of Award, unless otherwise specified in the contract. The e-PBG shall remain valid for a period extending6 0 days beyond the date of completion of all contractual and warranty obligations. F. Delivery, Transportation and Transit Liability 11. FOR Destination Price All quoted prices shall be on FOR Destination basis and shall be inclusive of all costs towards packing, forwarding, freight, transit insurance, loading, unloading and delivery. 12. Delivery Location The final delivery shall be made at the designated stores/location(s) of the Buyer within the Patnitop area, as spec ified in the purchase order/contract. In case any unit is damaged during transit, the supplier shall replace the damaged unit with a new compliant unit wi thin 7 days of formal notification by the Buyer, at no additional cost to the Buyer. G. Warranty and After-Sales Service 13. Comprehensive Warranty The supplier shall provide a minimum 12-month comprehensive warranty from the date of final acceptance of th e goods. The warranty shall cover manufacturing defects, structural deformation, premature cracking and other defects attrib utable to material, workmanship or manufacturing. 14. Availability of Critical Spares The supplier shall maintain adequate availability/inventory of critical spare parts during the warranty period. 15. On-Site Replacement / Maintenance Support During the warranty period, defective or damaged components shall be replaced/ repaired by the supplier at the de signated location in Patnitop. The supplier shall arrange replacement of defective critical components within 10 day s of receipt of the complaint, unless a shorter period is specifically stipulated elsewhere in the contract.

16. Local Service Support in Jammu & Kashmir The supplier shall have adequate service support in Jammu & Kashmir for attending warranty-related complaints an d shall ensure timely availability of service personnel and critical spare parts at the delivery location. The bidder/Su pplier shall have an established office in Jammu & Kashmir. The bidder must upload the documentary proof like rent agreement/ownership certificate for the same. H. Undertakings and Legal Declarations 17. Undertaking Regarding Debarment / Blacklisting The bidder shall submit an undertaking declaring that the bidder has not been debarred, blacklisted or suspended b y any Government Department, Urban Local Body or the GeM Portal during the preceding three years. Any misrepresentation or concealment of material facts discovered at any stage may result in action as per the appl icable bid/contract conditions, including forfeiture of EMD and/or termination of contract, as applicable. 18. Notarized Affidavit for Warranty Support The bidder shall submit a notarized affidavit on ₹100 non-judicial stamp paper confirming that the bidder shall p rovide on-site replacement of defective parts at Patnitop during warranty period. 19. The bidder shall also declare then ame, contact details and address of its authorized service executive/ service partner based in Jammu & Kashmir. Note: In the event of any discrepancy or conflict between the specifications, terms and conditions contained in the original bid document and those specifically incorporated b y the buyer through the Buyer added ATC, the specifications , terms and conditions sti pulated in the Buyer added ATC shall prevail and shall have overriding effect for the p urpose of interpretation , evaluation, execution and compliance of the bid/contract. . 3.
